versions.content: The value of the EcucModuleDef . postBuildVari- antSupport attribute in the VSMD in case it is not defined in the StMD If the postBuildVariantSupport attribute for an EcucModuleDef is not de- fined in the StMD, the corresponding VSMD can set it to either false or true .
